Run `pnpm test:macos` to check authenticated startup, restart, port conflicts, and process cleanup."},{"id":"p23s1","text":"### Start an existing `browser-agent` profile again"},{"id":"p24s1","text":"If you set up the older `browser-agent` profile from a checkout, start its backend with this command"},{"id":"p24s2","text":" the older `browser-agent` profile from a checkout, start its backend with this command on one line:"},{"id":"p25s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p26s1","text":"Keep the terminal open while using the extension, and press Ctrl+C to stop the backend."},{"id":"p27s1","text":"## Agent tools"},{"id":"p28s1","text":"List of tools the **agent** has access to by default"},{"id":"p29s1","text":"| Tool | What it does |"},{"id":"p30s1","text":"| `ask_user` | Asks the user for a missing choice or detail. |

[该节后续省略]"},{"id":"p31s1","text":"## What you can do"},{"id":"p32s1","text":"- Ask it to read a page, follow links, fill out fields, scroll, or take a screenshot.
- Run separate"},{"id":"p32s2","text":" chats in different tabs and switch between them as you work.
- Come back to a saved chat with its m"},{"id":"p32s3","text":"essages, tool activity, and recent website links.
- Attach an image or document and ask questions ab"},{"id":"p32s4","text":"out it.
- Turn individual tools on or off for each chat, with approval prompts for clicks, typing, a"},{"id":"p32s5","text":" individual tools on or off for each chat, with approval prompts for clicks, typing, and navigation."},{"id":"p33s1","text":"Image attachments can be PNG, JPEG, WebP, or GIF.
For documents, you can attach Word, PDF, CSV, Exce"},{"id":"p33s2","text":"l, PowerPoint, OpenDocument, RTF, EPUB, Markdown, and plain text files.
Documents are converted loca"},{"id":"p33s3","text":"lly before their text is sent to your model provider."},{"id":"p34s1","text":"## How it works"},{"id":"p35s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p36s1","text":"Your message goes through DSH to your chosen AI model.
If the model needs to read the page or click "},{"id":"p36s2","text":"something, it asks the extension to do that in your chat's tab.
The extension sends back the result,"},{"id":"p36s3","text":" and the model uses it to decide what to do next.
Those steps show up in the side panel as it works."},{"id":"p37s1","text":"The browser agent gets its own DSH installation and settings, so it won't replace an existing DSH se"},{"id":"p37s2","text":"tup.
Its dependencies are locked to tested versions to avoid mixing incompatible releases."},{"id":"p38s1","text":"## Privacy and control"},{"id":"p39s1","text":"The agent works on your real, signed-in tabs, so its actions affect your actual accounts.
That's why"},{"id":"p39s2","text":" approval prompts are on by default for clicks, typing, and navigation.
Use `/human-in-the-loop` to "},{"id":"p39s3","text":"turn them off or back on for the current chat."},{"id":"p40s1","text":"The connection between Chrome and DSH stays on your computer and uses a private token.
Your chats an"},{"id":"p40s2","text":"d saved tasks are stored in the local DSH browser-agent data directory, so they are shared across Ch"},{"id":"p40s3","text":"rome profiles using the same DSH installation and survive extension rebuilds.
Your chosen AI provide"},{"id":"p40s4","text":"r receives your messages and the page content the agent reads, along with any screenshots or attache"},{"id":"p40s5","text":"d images it uses.
Documents are converted to text locally before that text is sent to the provider; "},{"id":"p40s6","text":"scanned PDFs aren't uploaded or processed with OCR."},{"id":"p41s1","text":"For voice input, recordings go to the transcription provider you choose, and its API key is saved in"},{"id":"p41s2","text":" the extension's local settings.
Browser dictation uses Chrome's speech recognition instead.
Keep yo"},{"id":"p41s3","text":"ur extension data, DSH settings, and installation backups private: they can contain credentials and "},{"id":"p41s4","text":"personal information."},{"id":"p42s1","text":"The installer pulls from this repo's `main` branch, so only run it from sources you trust."}],"truncated":true}
